keyFindings.description: New in ae660532: the lift in resolve (:711-718) raises any removal waiting in the next batch for a client that is not listed, including one recorded before the read for a client that has since come back at a higher clock whose own record has not run yet. The old departure then goes out at the clock of the live state: the other process gets state 2, null 2, state 2, removes a live reader, and its browsers (which never purge tombstones) drop the final state 2, so the cursor is gone until the reader's next frame (up to ~15 s). The generator produces this schedule at the default count (seed 3047) and misses it; two reviewers reproduced it independently (41 schedules per 100k with a per-step monitor; 0 with the lift disabled). The comment at :651-658 claims it only covers a client taken off the list in that window.

check() (:611-652) runs once after drain() and reads the two ygo rooms only, so invariant (b) 'a live client is never removed' is not checked: a removal of a live client healed by its own later record, or hidden by the receiver's per-apply tombstone purge, passes. Check (b) at every step, and model a reader that never purges (a browser stand-in fed by every update the process applies). Add seed 3047 to relayScheduleRegressions.

Notes, not blocking: the generator lets a socket's next frame apply while its previous frame's observer is parked (production serialises one socket's frames); six windows are not parked (resolve between GetStates and EncodeUpdate, raise to send, localClients, answer between localClients and EncodeUpdate, touched between Meta and the snapshot, received between inject and purge); a parked run of all six found no new class. The flush-serialisation fault is found only by its pinned seed at the default count (26 per 100k unseeded).

verified: Round-8 item 1: resolve raises local to the sent clock under r.mu, listed clients only, never relisting (7c2de26f); with the raise removed the generator fails seed 739 (I1) at the default count.
Round-8 item 2: the lock-guard observer waits on <-queued alone; one deadline.
Round-8 items 3-4: one driver for both heartbeat orders with the bounded wait; comments corrected.

Generator coverage: record, resolve, answer, heartbeat, removal (own socket, another tab's echo, localRemoval on close), purge and flush on both relays, at any step, parking in beforeWatch/beforeSnapshot/beforeRecord/beforeAnswerRecord/beforeResolve/beforeRaise; deterministic by seed. Mutations (i) round-7 state rule reverted, (ii) resolve raise removed, (iii) stale removals dropped unread, (iv) touched builds no removal: each fails at the default count with a seed that replays identically. Unmodified: PASS 10,000 in ~4 s, 100,000 in 53 s.

Production seams: the Service's awarenessHost methods do what the old direct calls did (time.AfterFunc, srv.GetAwareness, srv.Inject, roomSyncSender.Notify); window hooks nil in production; one flush per room through `flushing` under r.mu, sends outside r.mu, Close still waits for every send.
